I, Gayantha Karunatilleke, Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms, hereby declare under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the lands described below is needed for apublic purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

The allotments of Land depicted in Advance Tracing No.CO/KTT/2017/405 and dated 12th September, 2017 prepared bythe Surveyor-General, situated at Pitakotte (within Ward No.6 -Pitakotte Sri Jayawardanapura Kotte Municipal Council) in theDivisional Secretary’s Division of Sri Jayawardanapura Kotte in theColombo District in Western Province computed to certain in extent0.1317 hectare and bounded:
01. Lot ‘A’ – Madatiyagahawatta – Extent: 0.1317 HectareNorth: land bearing Assmt. No. 163/3, Thalawathugoda Road,cemented drainage and name unknown land; East: name unknown

land, Assmt. No. 171/1, Thalawathugoda Road and land bearing No.171/1/A; South:land bearing Assmt. No. 171/1 and 171/1/AThalawathugoda Road and Thalawathugoda Road; West:Thalawathugoda Road, land bearing Assmt. No. 163/3,Thalawathugoda Road and cemented drainage.
Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
